transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm just here because... I don't know. I still get through my driving routes, and I show up for my volunteer shifts, but... there's just this heavy, low feeling. It's sitting on me most days. Like I'm just going through the motions, you know? Not really... living my own life. Just getting by.
How long have you been experiencing this heavy, low feeling?
A while. Um... probably about three years, I guess. ...That's when my dad passed away. So... yeah. Since then.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before your dad passed away?
I don't know. I guess... I haven't really thought about it much. I mostly just work my routes and go home. So... hard to say, really.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but no longer find pleasure in?
I'm... not really sure. Like I said, I just... I mostly just work. I don't really do much else anymore. Just... haven't really felt like it.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?
I mean... kinda like I just said. I don't really know. I just haven't paid much attention to it... just been doing my routes and sleeping, mostly. So I can't really give you a yes or no on that.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things that used to bring you pleasure?
Look, doc... you keep asking me the exact same thing. I don't have a different answer for you. I really don't know. I just drive my truck and go home. That's... that's all there is to it.
Do you feel like you've been able to experience pleasure or happiness at all during the past three years?
I... I don't really know. I guess I just don't think about it like that. I'm just getting through the days. I don't really sit around wondering if I'm happy or not.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
Guilty? ...No. Not really. I don't know what I'd have to feel guilty about. I just go to work and mind my own business.
Have you noticed any change in how much you enjoy social interactions with others?
Not really. I don't... I don't really go out much anyway. Just talk to the guys at the yard when I need to. It's about the same as it's always been, I guess.
Do you feel like you've been moving slower or faster than usual?
No. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... moving at my normal pace, I guess. Still getting my routes done.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?
No. ...No, never. I wouldn't do anything like that.
Have you noticed any change in your weight over the past three years?
Not really. I don't weigh myself much, but... my clothes still fit the same. So, no.
Do you often feel worthless?

I don't know about worthless, but... I don't feel like I measure up. I just... I look at the kind of man my dad was, and... well. I'm not that. Nobody says it to me, but... I just hear it in my own head, I guess. That I should be further along by now. Should be handling things better than I am.
Do you often think about death?
No. I don't... no. I don't really think about that. Just trying to get by, mostly.
Have you ever felt like things would be better if you weren't around?
No. I... no. Never really crossed my mind. I just keep my head down and do my job.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?

Not more, no. Probably less, honestly. Nights before a run, I'll just... I lie there thinking about the next day's stops. Or I'll wake up around four and not really get back to sleep. So... even when I make it to work on time, I just feel like I'm starting the day already worn down.
Do you feel like you've been feeling restless or fidgety lately?
No, not really. I mean... I sit behind the wheel most of the day. So, no. I don't think so.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt really down for a couple of weeks, and then felt better for a while after that?
No, I don't think so. It doesn't really go up and down like that for me. It's just... pretty much the same all the time, I guess.
Has your low feeling ever lifted for a while, or has it been constant since your dad passed away?
No, it hasn't really lifted. It's just... constant, I guess. It's been about three years now, since he died. So, yeah. Just the same.
Has your heavy, low feeling been present nearly every day since your dad passed away?

Yeah... pretty much every day. I mean, I still get through my routes for work, and my volunteer shifts. But... yeah. There's just this heavy feeling sitting on me most days. Like I'm just going through the motions... not really being in my own life anymore. I guess that's why I finally came in.
